scripts.build: pnpm --filter web build && rm -rf apps/api/public && mkdir -p apps/api/public && cp -r apps/web/dist/. apps/api/public/ && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.start:prod: pnpm build && pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate deploy && node apps/api/dist/main.js
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter api exec prisma db seed
